description: Fan-out de check_compliance para N jurisdições em uma chamada. Aggregate scores cross-border + identifica common gaps (que aparecem em ≥2 jurisdições) + jurisdiction-specific gaps + dedup recommendations. Use case: audit de empresa multinacional que opera sob LGPD+GDPR+CCPA+APPI+PIPA simultaneamente. Reutiliza article-by-article checklist do check_compliance por jurisdição (LGPD/GDPR full + outras 13 via keyArticles + boolean overlay).

aggregateBy.description: Estratégia de agregação do score (default: average). min é mais conservador (pior caso); max é otimista; average é balanceado.

hasCASPAuthorization.description: MiCA Art. 60-61 — CASP authorisation from competent authority

hasCASPCustodyRegister.description: MiCA Art. 75 — custody register + quarterly statements

hasCASPGovernance.description: MiCA Art. 68 — robust governance + organisational structure

hasCASPSegregation.description: MiCA Art. 75 — client-asset segregation + daily reconciliation

issuesART.description: Project issues Asset-Referenced Tokens (MiCA Title III). When false AND issuesEMT false, MICAR Title III articles are marked Not Applicable instead of gaps.

issuesEMT.description: Project issues E-Money Tokens (MiCA Title IV). Same scoping effect as issuesART.

jurisdictions.description: Array de codes ou aliases (LGPD/GDPR/APPI/JP/JAPAN/etc.). Min 2. Codes válidos: LGPD, GDPR, DPDP, MICAR, MICAR-CASP, PDPA, UAE, POPIA, NDPA, CCPA, PIPEDA, LAW25, PIPA, PDP, APPI, MEXICO, VIETNAM, MALAYSIA, KENYA, GHANA, COLOMBIA, TANZANIA, RWANDA, UGANDA, ARGENTINA. Aliases resolvidos automaticamente.

operatesCASP.description: Project operates any of the 10 CASP services (Title V). When true, the tool auto-adds MICAR-CASP to the jurisdiction set if not already requested. When explicitly false, MICAR-CASP articles are marked Not Applicable.

name: multi_jurisdiction_compliance_check
